section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1976
title: Volume of suicides for Union Territories, as a whole, per lakh of population was 8.33 the maximum was for A & N Islands (55.47) and the minimum was for Arunachal Pradesh (1.54). The volume of suicides for Metropolitan Cities as a whole was 5.33 per lakh of population. The volume of suicides per lakh of population among the Metropolitan Cities ranged between 17.71 and 1.34. The maximum volume of suicides was for Bangalore (17.71) and the minimum was for Calcutta (1.34). The details are presented in Table 5. notes: Distribution of Suicides According to Age & Sex

The statistics of suicides by age revealed that the maximum suicides were committed by persons belonging to the age group 18 to 30 years (44.2 per cent of the total suicide cases reported) 29.1 per cent of the total suicides were committed by persons belonging to age group 30 to 50 years. Persons committing suicide below 18 years of age accounted for 14.6 per cent of the total and persons belonging to above 50 years of age accounted for 12.1 percent of the total suicides reported during 1976. The pattern of suicides age-wise was almost the same for States, Union Territories and for India as a whole. The age pattern of persons committing suicides during 1976 was almost the same as that for 1975. The detailed statistics are set forth in Table 6.
